svg.title: How a payment stays safe
svg.desc: A buyer checks out, stock is reserved with a conditional update, Razorpay takes the payment, a signed and idempotent webhook confirms the order. If the payment never arrives, a BullMQ job releases the stock.

text.font-family: 'SC Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: CLIENT WORK · A PAYMENT THAT CANNOT BE CHARGED TWICE
